name: Pydantic AI Typed Agent Runtime
mechanism: Builds typed Python agents with validated dependencies, tools and outputs and attaches optional Temporal, DBOS, Prefect or Restate durable execution.
use_when: Typed Python boundaries and provider flexibility are primary requirements
Durability should be composed through a supported workflow integration
avoid_when: The product requires a complete multi-channel operational agent platform
The team cannot test replay constraints imposed by the selected durable backend
expected_effects: Strong validation at model, tool and application boundaries
Composable separation between agent semantics and durable execution
failure_modes: Schema validation creates false confidence in semantic correctness
Durable replay conflicts with dynamic or non-deterministic tool behavior
Rapid capability API evolution breaks wrappers or plugins
required_evals: upgrade migration for capability and tool interfaces
